issuing_orgs: National Institute on Minority Health and Health Disparities
synopsis: This PAR is being reissued in accordance with the simplified review criteria in effect for application due dates after January 25, 2025. The objective of this funding opportunity is to support non-pharmacological interventions to promote sleep health, reduce sleep health disparities, and examine sleep as a modifiable factor to reduce health disparities for other health outcomes among populations that experience health disparities.
title: Interventions to Reduce Sleep Health Disparities (R01 - Clinical Trials Optional)
